title: About KPGU | Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University
content: USH, GNC , INC & GSCPT Approved KPGU at a Glance.   Implemented Comprehensive Research Policy to motivate faculty and students to conduct research, that led to complete 101 Research Projects amounting to   32 Lakhs from AICTE & GUJCOST and 4.50 Crores from SSIP and SOIC.   Grant sanctioned from Govt. Agencies: 3 Cr from Startup India- Govt. of India and 2 Cr from GKS under SSIP, Govt. of Gujarat in 2022.
